notes: Living in a city with an apartment, crew turf, shops and cosmetics is open-ended street roleplay, so Roleplay & Avatar Sim leads; Simulation is named second because the author's answer turns 'jobs' into a defined repeatable loop — delivery, cashier, gym cleaning, each started and finished at its own location — and only its trigger-task and station-training express a job station and a strength-and-stamina gym, which no Roleplay row covers. Shape is settlement-claimable, the genre's housing decision: apartments and the three turf sizes are pre-built lots acquired and dressed with crew cosmetics, never constructed, so settlement-buildable is wrong, and world-open was rejected because 'open world' describes the city being continuous while saying nothing about the personal property the prompt is actually made of. Took the Life preset whole — vehicle roads earned by the car dealership, district-zoned to split the shop strip from the turf neighbourhoods, building-interior for apartments, shops, gym and the mansion the prompt says has cosmetics inside it — and added settlement-density for the small dense city the author specified plus landmark-focal so the blue FTD mansion reads as the navigable anchor it is. Decided without a user that Robux prices and coin amounts are monetization with no layout consequence, and that the three turf tiers become three lot sizes across the neighbourhoods; P3 is genuine since the apartments, shops and mansion interior are all entered.
